evals.prompt: The repository's native mise bootstrap now runs the full lifecycle. Move a new repeatable package maintenance command into the correct declaration and keep the mise environment shim thin.
evals.expected_output: The response places the command in the owning module hook, keeps native mise bootstrap as the lifecycle owner, and avoids duplicating declarative work in the environment shim.
assertions: Places package maintenance in the owning post-packages hook.
Keeps scripts/mise-env.zsh focused on repository environment setup.
Preserves the full repository-scoped bootstrap without script-maintained phase filters.
Does not add a script-maintained phase allowlist.
Adds or updates focused lifecycle tests.

evals.prompt: Update the mise initialization lifecycle. Preserve the repository boundary and task resolution, keep native mise bootstrap and the profile confirmation before packages, and stop later work when bootstrap fails.
evals.expected_output: The response preserves the existing repository-scoped context and task resolution, native bootstrap confirmation, profile validation before sensitive phases, fail-fast behavior, and rerun-after-failure recovery guidance.
assertions: Preserves the existing repository-scoped context and task resolution.
Uses native mise bootstrap confirmation and the profile confirmation before package bootstrap.
Validates the selected profile before profile-sensitive bootstrap phases.
Preserves fail-fast behavior after bootstrap failure.
Verifies that mise runs before VM, OS, and BetterDisplay phases.
